changelog:
Initial release of AgentMail — an API-first email platform for AI agents.

- Create and manage inboxes programmatically with API
- Send and receive emails with support for rich content and attachments
- Real-time webhook support for incoming message events and workflow automation
- Advanced features: semantic search, automatic labeling, structured data extraction
- Security guidance for handling webhook prompt injection risks with sender allowlisting
- Python SDK, setup guides, and ready-to-use scripts for common email operations
